consequence.statement: The shipped default promtail config for rpm/deb packages changed to avoid possible high CPU use with many files in /var/log; the evidence does not state any failure.

assertion.statement: The default promtail configuration shipped with rpm/deb packages was improved to avoid possible high CPU utilisation when /var/log contains many files.
